en.s: The Battle of Chang'an, also known as the Sack of Chang'an, took place in the western Chinese imperial capital city of Chang'an on 28 June 192, at the end of the Han dynasty, the prelude of the Three Kingdoms.

zh.s: 长安之战又称长安之劫，发生于192年6月28日。东汉末年，三国时代即将到来之际，战斗在中国西部的帝都长安爆发。

en.s: The Zanj occupation of al-Ubulla (Arabic: دخول الزنج الأبلة) was an event of the Zanj Rebellion, occurring on June 28, 870. Zanj troops dispatched by their leader 'Ali ibn Muhammad advanced against the city of al-Ubulla on the Tigris and launched an attack against it. Despite a defense set up by the Abbasid government to protect the city, it was successfully stormed and taken by the rebels.

zh.s: 赞吉军攻占乌布拉是赞吉起义中的一次战斗，发生于870年6月28日。赞吉军领袖阿里·伊本·穆罕默德派部队向底格里斯河畔的乌布拉城推进并发起进攻。阿拔斯王朝政府虽布置防线保护该城，起义军仍成功攻入并占领了乌布拉。

en.s: The Battle of Antioch (1098) was a military engagement fought between the Christian forces of the First Crusade and a Muslim coalition led by Kerbogha, atabeg of Mosul. Kerbogha's goal was to reclaim Antioch from the Crusaders and affirm his position as a regional power.

zh.s: 第一次十字军东征期间，基督教军队与由摩苏尔阿塔贝格克尔布加率领的穆斯林联军在安条克交战。克尔布加意图从十字军手中夺回安条克，并巩固自己在该地区的势力。

en.t: Battle of the Field of Blood
en.s: In the Battle of Ager Sanguinis, also known as the Battle of the Field of Blood, the Battle of Sarmada, or the Battle of Balat, Roger of Salerno's Crusader army of the Principality of Antioch was annihilated by the army of Ilghazi of Mardin, the Artuqid ruler of Aleppo on 28 June 1119.

zh.s: 血战原野战役又称阿格尔·桑吉尼斯战役、萨尔马达战役或巴拉特战役。1119年6月28日，萨莱诺的罗杰率领的安条克公国十字军，被来自马尔丁、统治阿勒颇的阿尔图格王朝君主伊尔加齐的军队全歼。

en.s: The siege of Villa di Chiesa (today Iglesias) was carried out by the army of the Crown of Aragon (under the command of Alfonso IV of Aragon) and of the giudicato of Arborea, between the summer of 1323 and the winter of 1324. It represented the first act of the Aragonese conquest of Pisan Sardinia, for the creation of the Kingdom of Sardinia.

zh.s: 1323年夏至1324年冬，阿拉贡王室军队（由阿方索四世指挥）与阿尔博雷亚地方政权的军队围攻维拉迪基耶萨（今伊格莱西亚斯）。这是阿拉贡征服比萨治下的撒丁岛、建立撒丁王国的第一步。

en.s: The Battle of Billericay took place on 28 June 1381 when the boy King Richard II's soldiers defeated the Essex rebels adjacent to a wood north-east of Billericay, part of the Peasants' Revolt. This is likely to have been Norsey Wood which maps of 1593 show to cover the same extent as in the early 20th century. The king's forces were led by Thomas of Woodstock, the Earl of Buckingham and Sir Thomas Percy. It is thought that 500 Essexmen were killed and buried at Great Burstead churchyard and 800 horses were captured.

zh.s: 比勒里基战役于1381年6月28日爆发。理查二世国王的军队在比勒里基东北方向的一处林地旁击败埃塞克斯叛军，这是农民起义的一部分。战场很可能位于诺西森林；1593年的地图显示，当时森林范围与20世纪初相同。国王军由白金汉伯爵伍德斯托克的托马斯和托马斯·珀西爵士率领。据估计，500名埃塞克斯人被杀并葬于大伯斯特德教堂墓地，另有800匹马被俘。

en.t: Edward IV is crowned at Westminster Abbey
en.s: On June 28, 1461, Edward IV was crowned King of England at Westminster Abbey in London.

zh.t: 爱德华四世在威斯敏斯特教堂加冕
zh.s: 1461年6月28日，爱德华四世在伦敦威斯敏斯特教堂加冕为英格兰国王。

en.s: The Battle of Seminara, part of the First Italian War, was fought in Calabria on 28 June 1495 between a French garrison in recently conquered Southern Italy and the allied forces of Spain and Naples which were attempting to reconquer these territories. Against the redoubtable combination of gendarmes and Swiss mercenary pikemen in the French force, the allies had only Neapolitan troops of indifferent quality and a small corps of lightly-armed Spanish soldiers, accustomed to fighting the Moors of Spain. The result was a rout, and much of the fighting centered on delaying actions to permit the fleeing allied force to escape.

zh.s: 塞米纳拉战役是第一次意大利战争的一部分，于1495年6月28日在卡拉布里亚爆发。交战双方是刚征服意大利南部的法军守军，以及试图收复这些领土的西班牙和那不勒斯联军。法军拥有强大的重骑兵和瑞士雇佣长枪兵；联军只有战力一般的那不勒斯军队，以及一小支装备轻便、惯于与西班牙摩尔人作战的西班牙士兵。联军惨败，战斗中有许多部队为掩护溃退的友军撤离而拖延法军。

en.s: The Battle of Soltau (German: Schlacht bei Soltau) took place on 28 June 1519 and was the military climax of the Hildesheim Diocesan Feud which lasted from 1519–1523. Some sources describe it as "the last knights' battle" (Die letzte Ritterschlacht). It is also often described as the "last medieval feud". The feud had all the hallmarks of a typical dispute between noble families of that time. At its heart was the division of revenue and territorial claims, mainly on the land of the Bishopric of Hildesheim. Two aspects, however, made it rather different.

zh.s: 索尔陶战役（德语：Schlacht bei Soltau）于1519年6月28日爆发，是希尔德斯海姆教区纷争的军事高潮。这场纷争持续于1519至1523年。有些资料称索尔陶战役是“最后一场骑士之战”，也常将这场纷争称为“最后一场中世纪封建战争”。纷争具有当时贵族家族争端的典型特征，核心是收益分配和领土主张，主要涉及希尔德斯海姆主教领地。

en.s: The Battle of Nagashino (長篠の戦い, Nagashino no Tatakai) was a famous battle in Japanese history, fought in 1575 at Nagashino in Mikawa Province (present-day Nagashino, Shinshiro, Aichi Prefecture). The allied forces of Oda Nobunaga and Tokugawa Ieyasu (38,000) fought against Takeda Katsuyori's forces (15,000) and the allied forces won a crushing victory over the Takeda clan. As a result, Oda Nobunaga's unification of Japan was seen as certain.

zh.s: 长筱之战（長篠の戦い）是日本史上的著名战役，1575年在三河国长筱（今爱知县新城市长筱）爆发。织田信长和德川家康率领的联军（3.8万人）与武田胜赖的部队（1.5万人）交战，联军大获全胜，重创武田氏。此后，织田信长统一日本似乎已成定局。

en.s: Yonekura Shigetsugu (died 1575) was a famous Japanese samurai and a member of the Takeda clan.

zh.s: 1575年6月28日，日本武田家武士米仓重继在长筱之战中阵亡。

en.s: The Siege of Venlo of 1586, also known as the Capture of Venlo, was a Spanish victory that took place on June 28, 1586, at the city of Venlo, in the southeastern of Low Countries, near the German border (present-day Province of Limburg, the Netherlands), between the Spanish forces commanded by Governor-General Don Alexander Farnese, Prince of Parma (Spanish: Alejandro Farnesio), and the Dutch garrison of Venlo, supported by relief troops under Maarten Schenck van Nydeggen and Sir Roger Williams, during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo-Spanish War (1585–1604).

zh.s: 1586年6月28日，西班牙军队攻占低地国家东南部、靠近德国边境的芬洛（今属荷兰林堡省），取得胜利。围城战发生于八十年战争和英西战争期间，西班牙军由总督帕尔马亲王亚历山德罗·法尔内塞指挥；芬洛荷兰守军得到马尔滕·申克·范·尼德赫根和罗杰·威廉姆斯爵士率领的援军支持。

en.s: The Battle of Berestechko (28 June – 10 July 1651) was fought between the Cossack Hetmanate and Crimean Khanate against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth as a part of the Khmelnytsky Uprising.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 别列斯捷奇科战役于1651年6月28日至7月10日爆发，交战双方是哥萨克酋长国和克里米亚汗国联军，以及波兰—立陶宛联邦。这场战役是赫梅利尼茨基起义的一部分。

en.s: The siege of Lyakhavichy or Lachowicze took place from 23 March to 28 June 1660 during the Russo-Polish War (1654–67). Lachowicze was one of the major Grand Duchy of Lithuania strongholds in the disputed region (modern Belarus). A Russian army of about 11,000 under Ivan Nikitich Khovansky laid siege to the castle, defended by Mikołaj Judycki.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 利亚霍维奇围城战又称拉霍维奇围城战，于1660年3月23日至6月28日在俄波战争（1654—1667年）期间进行。拉霍维奇是立陶宛大公国在争议地区（今白俄罗斯）的重要据点之一。伊万·尼基季奇·霍万斯基率领约11,000名俄军围困城堡，守军由米科瓦伊·尤迪茨基指挥。

en.s: The Siege of Cuneo was fought on 28 June 1691 during Nine Years' War in Piedmont-Savoy, modern-day northern Italy. The siege was part of King Louis XIV’s campaign against Victor Amadeus, the Duke of Savoy, who had sided with the Grand Alliance the previous year. The siege was an attempt to gain a foothold on the Piedmont Plain, thus ensuring Marshal Catinat's army could winter east of the Alps.

zh.s: 库内奥围城战于1691年6月28日在皮埃蒙特—萨伏依地区爆发，属于九年战争的一部分。路易十四国王向维克托·阿梅迪奥公爵及其领地发起攻势；公爵于前一年加入大同盟。法国围城的目的是在皮埃蒙特平原建立据点，以便卡蒂纳元帅的军队在阿尔卑斯山以东过冬。

en.s: The Expedition of Larache occurred in June 1765 when French Navy Marines attempted to invade the Moroccan city of Larache following a bombardment of Salé and Rabat. It is an example of the sporadic failure of Western arms against local forces in colonial campaigns.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1765年6月，法国海军陆战队炮击萨莱和拉巴特后，试图入侵摩洛哥城市拉腊什，这次行动被称为拉腊什远征。此事体现了西方殖民军事行动偶尔会败于当地武装。

en.s: The Battle of Sullivan's Island or the Battle of Fort Sullivan was fought on June 28, 1776, during the American Revolutionary War. It took place near Charleston, South Carolina, during the first British attempt to capture the city from American forces. It is also sometimes referred to as the first siege of Charleston, owing to a more successful British siege in 1780.

zh.s: 沙利文岛战役又称沙利文堡战役，于1776年6月28日在美国独立战争期间爆发，战场位于南卡罗来纳州查尔斯顿附近。这是英军首次试图从美军手中夺取该市。由于英军1780年更成功的围城战，这场战役有时也称查尔斯顿第一次围城战。

en.t: Draft Declaration of Independence presented to Congress
en.s: The Committee of Five submitted a draft of the Declaration of Independence to the Second Continental Congress. Thomas Jefferson had prepared the draft, which John Adams, Benjamin Franklin and the committee revised before its presentation.

en.s: The Battle of Monmouth was an American Revolutionary War battle fought on June 28, 1778 in Monmouth County, New Jersey. The Continental Army under General George Washington attacked the rear of the British Army column commanded by Lieutenant General Sir Henry Clinton as they left Monmouth Court House (modern Freehold Borough). It is also known as the Battle of Monmouth Courthouse. Unsteady handling of lead Continental elements by Major General Charles Lee had allowed British rearguard commander Lieutenant General Charles Cornwallis to seize the initiative, but Washington's timely arrival on the battlefield rallied the Americans along a hilltop hedgerow.

zh.s: 蒙茅斯战役于1778年6月28日在美国新泽西州蒙茅斯县爆发，是美国独立战争的一场战役，也称蒙茅斯法院大楼战役。乔治·华盛顿将军率领大陆军，袭击亨利·克林顿中将指挥的英军纵队后卫；英军当时正撤离蒙茅斯法院大楼（今弗里霍尔德自治市）。大陆军先头部队由查尔斯·李少将指挥，但指挥不稳，英军后卫指挥官查尔斯·康沃利斯中将因此抢得主动权。华盛顿及时赶到战场，在山顶树篱一带重新鼓舞美军。

en.s: The Battle of Uttismalm took place on June 28, 1789 during Gustav III's Russian War, Sweden won over the Russian Empire. The Swedish troops were in personal command of the king Gustav III and numbered about 2,500 men. The Russian troops were of equal size and lost 100 dead and about 300 wounded in the battle. The Swedes lost 14 men dead and 88 men wounded.

zh.s: 1789年6月28日，古斯塔夫三世对俄战争期间，瑞典军队在乌蒂斯马尔姆战役中击败俄罗斯帝国军队。瑞典国王古斯塔夫三世亲自指挥约2,500名士兵。双方兵力相当；俄军阵亡100人、约300人受伤，瑞典军阵亡14人、受伤88人。

en.s: The War of the Second Coalition (French: Guerre de la Deuxième Coalition) (1798–1802) was the second war between revolutionary France and a coalition of European monarchies, led by Britain, Austria and Russia, and including the Ottoman Empire, Portugal, Naples and various German monarchies. Prussia did not join the coalition, while Spain supported France.

zh.s: 1798年至1802年，英国、奥地利和俄罗斯领导的欧洲君主国联盟与革命后的法国交战，史称第二次反法同盟战争。奥斯曼帝国、葡萄牙、那不勒斯和多个德意志邦国也加入联盟；普鲁士没有参战，西班牙则支持法国。

en.s: The Action of 28 June 1803 marked the opening shots of the Blockade of Saint-Domingue after the collapse of the Treaty of Amiens and the outbreak of the War of the Third Coalition in May 1803. A French heavy frigate and a corvette, both partially armed en flûte and unaware of the recently begun war, met three British 74-gun ships of the line. The corvette was overhauled and captured, but the frigate, sailing close to shore, managed to out-manoeuver her opponent and deliver a devastating raking broadside that put her out of action.

zh.s: 1803年6月28日的海战打响了圣多明各封锁战的第一枪。1803年5月《亚眠条约》瓦解、第三次反法同盟战争爆发后，一艘法国重型护卫舰和一艘轻型护卫舰遭遇三艘英国74炮战列舰。两艘法国舰艇都部分拆除火炮以装载货物，且不知道战争已经爆发。英国军舰追上并俘获了轻型护卫舰；重型护卫舰贴近岸边航行，成功避开对手，并以猛烈的纵向炮击使其失去战斗力。

en.s: On June 28, 1808, defenders of Valencia, Spain, repelled an assault by French forces under Marshal Bon-Adrien Jeannot de Moncey during the Peninsular War. Moncey’s forces failed to capture the city.
en.n: This entry records the assault repelled on June 28, rather than treating every stage of the operation as a single-day event.

zh.t: 瓦伦西亚守军击退蒙塞的进攻
zh.s: 1808年6月28日，半岛战争期间，西班牙瓦伦西亚守军击退了蒙塞元帅率领的法军进攻。法军未能攻下这座城市。
zh.n: 此条记录的是6月28日被击退的进攻，并非说整场行动都发生在当天。

en.s: The Battle of Grodno was one of the first battles that took place on 27–28 June at the initial stage of the Patriotic War of 1812 between the vanguard of the right wing of Napoleon's Grand Army and the rearguard of the Russian 2nd Western Army.

zh.s: 格罗德诺战役是1812年6月27日至28日卫国战争初期的早期战斗之一，交战双方是拿破仑大军右翼先头部队与俄军第二西方面军后卫部队。

en.s: The sinking of HMS Reindeer was a naval action of the War of 1812 which took place on 28 June 1814. The ship-rigged sloop of war USS Wasp forced the Cruizer-class brig-sloop HMS Reindeer to strike her colours after far more than half the brig's crew, including her captain, Commander William Manners, were killed or wounded. Reindeer was too badly damaged in the action to be salvaged so the Americans burnt her.

zh.s: “驯鹿号”沉没事件是1812年战争期间的一场海战，发生于1814年6月28日。美国海军“黄蜂号”战舰迫使英国海军“驯鹿号”双桅炮舰降旗投降；英舰船员中远超半数伤亡，包括舰长威廉·曼纳斯。英舰受损严重，无法修复，美军随后将其焚毁。

en.s: The Battle of La Suffel was a French victory over Austrian forces of the Seventh Coalition and the last French pitched battle victory in the Napoleonic Wars. It was fought on 28 June 1815 at Souffelweyersheim and Hoenheim, near Strasbourg. During the Hundred Days, General Jean Rapp rallied to Napoleon Bonaparte and was given command of the V Corps (also known as the Army of the Rhine), consisting of about 20,000 men. He was ordered to observe the border near Strasbourg, and to defend the Vosges.

zh.s: 拉叙费尔战役是法国对第七次反法同盟军中奥军的一场胜利，也是拿破仑战争期间法国最后一次在正规会战中取胜。战役于1815年6月28日在斯特拉斯堡附近的苏费尔韦尔赛姆和厄南爆发。百日王朝期间，拉普将军重新效忠拿破仑·波拿巴，并获任第五军团（又称莱茵军团）指挥官，麾下约有20,000人。拉普奉命观察斯特拉斯堡附近边境并守卫孚日山脉。

en.s: The Battle of Macta was fought on 28 June 1835 between French forces under General Camille Alphonse Trézel and a coalition of Algerian Berber tribal warriors under Emir Abd al-Qadir during the French conquest of Algeria. The French column, which had fought an inconclusive but somewhat bloody battle with Abdul-Qadir a few days earlier, was retreating toward Arzew to resupply when Abdul-Qadir attacked in the marshes on the banks of the Macta River in what is now western Algeria. The French panicked and fled to Arzew in a disorganized rout. The Algerians piled the heads of their defeated French enemies in a pyramid, allegedly hundreds in total.

zh.s: 马克塔战役于1835年6月28日爆发，交战双方是卡米耶·阿方斯·特雷泽尔将军率领的法军，以及埃米尔阿卜杜勒·卡迪尔领导的阿尔及利亚柏柏尔部族联军，是法国征服阿尔及利亚期间的一场战斗。此前，法军纵队几天前曾与阿卜杜勒·卡迪尔交战，双方未分胜负，法军也伤亡惨重。法军正向阿尔泽夫撤退以补充物资时，阿卜杜勒·卡迪尔在如今阿尔及利亚西部的马克塔河沼泽地发动袭击。法军惊慌溃逃至阿尔泽夫。阿尔及利亚人把阵亡法军的头颅堆成金字塔，据称总数达数百个。

en.s: The coronation of Victoria as queen of the United Kingdom took place on Thursday, 28 June 1838, just over a year after she succeeded to the throne of the United Kingdom at the age of 18. The ceremony was held in Westminster Abbey after a public procession through the streets from Buckingham Palace, to which the Queen returned later as part of a second procession.

zh.s: 1838年6月28日（星期四），维多利亚在英国威斯敏斯特教堂加冕为联合王国女王。她在一年多前、18岁时继承王位。仪式前，她从白金汉宫乘车队穿过街道前往教堂；随后她又乘另一支车队返回白金汉宫。

en.s: The Battle of Raab took place during the Summer Campaign of the Hungarian War of Independence. It was fought on 28 June 1849 in the city of Raab, Hungary (now known as Győr). The Hungarian Revolutionary Army was led by General Ernő Poeltenberg and General Artúr Görgei. The Austrian Empire was led by Julius Jacob von Haynau, with assistance from a Russian division led by Feodor Sergeyevich Panyutyin.

zh.s: 杰尔战役是匈牙利独立战争夏季战役的一部分，于1849年6月28日在当时称拉布的匈牙利杰尔市爆发。匈牙利革命军由埃尔诺·波尔滕贝格将军和阿图尔·格尔盖伊将军率领；奥地利帝国军队由尤利乌斯·雅各布·冯·海瑙率领，并得到费奥多尔·谢尔盖耶维奇·帕纽金指挥的俄军师支援。

en.t: Sigma Chi fraternity is founded in North America
en.s: Sigma Chi (ΣΧ) is one of the largest North American social fraternities. The fraternity has 244 active undergraduate chapters and 152 alumni chapters in the United States and Canada and has initiated over 350,000 members. It was founded on June 28, 1855, at Miami University in Oxford, Ohio, by members who split from the Delta Kappa Epsilon fraternity.

zh.s: 西格玛·契兄弟会（ΣΧ）是北美规模最大的社交兄弟会之一，在美国和加拿大设有244个活跃的本科分会和152个校友分会，累计吸纳成员超过35万人。该组织于1855年6月28日在俄亥俄州牛津的迈阿密大学成立，创办者原属德尔塔·卡帕·埃普西隆兄弟会，后来分离出来。

zh.s: 唐纳森维尔第二次战役于1863年6月28日在路易斯安那州阿森松堂区爆发，是美国内战的一场战役。

en.s: The Battle of Sappony Church, also known as the Battle of Stony Creek Depot, was an engagement of the American Civil War, between the Confederate States of America and the Union, which took place on June 28, 1864, during the Wilson-Kautz Raid of the Richmond–Petersburg Campaign.

en.s: The Battle of Burkersdorf was fought on June 28, 1866, during the Austro-Prussian War. It featured the Austrian X Corps against the Prussian Guard Corps and ended in a Prussian victory.

en.s: The Battle of Münchengrätz (German: Schlacht bei Münchengrätz) or Battle of Mnichovo Hradiště (Czech: Bitva u Mnichova Hradiště) was fought near Mnichovo Hradiště, modern day Czech Republic, on 28 June 1866 during the Austro-Prussian War. It ended in a Prussian victory over the Austrian Empire.

zh.s: 明兴格雷茨战役（德语：Schlacht bei Münchengrätz；捷克语：Bitva u Mnichova Hradiště）于1866年6月28日在如今捷克共和国的姆尼霍沃赫拉迪什捷附近爆发，属于普奥战争的一部分。普鲁士军队击败奥地利帝国军队。

en.s: The Battle of Skalitz was a minor engagement in the Königgratz/Sadowa campaign of the Austro-Prussian War of 1866 in Bohemia on 28 June. Following the Prussian victory at the Battle of Náchod the previous day (27 June), the Prussian forces, led by General of the Infantry Steinmetz, advanced on Skalitz (Česká Skalice) and defeated the forces of Archduke Leopold.

zh.s: 斯卡利茨战役是1866年普奥战争克尼格雷茨战役行动中的一场小规模交战，于6月28日在波希米亚爆发。普鲁士军队前一天在纳霍德战役中获胜后，在施泰因梅茨步兵上将率领下向斯卡利茨（今捷克切斯卡斯卡利采）推进，并击败利奥波德大公率领的奥军。

en.s: The Austro-Serbian Convention of 1881 (German: Geheimvertrag zwischen Österreich-Ungarn und Serbien |Hungarian: Osztrák-magyar–szerb titkos egyezmény |Serbian: Аустро-српски савез из 1881) was a secret bilateral treaty that was signed in Belgrade on 28 June 1881 by Gabriel Freiherr Herbert-Rathkeal on behalf of Austria-Hungary and by Čedomilj Mijatović on behalf of the Principality of Serbia. The convention effectively turned Serbia into a protectorate state of Austria-Hungary, which meant its accession by proxy to the subsequent Triple Alliance (1882).

zh.s: 1881年奥塞公约是一项秘密双边条约，1881年6月28日在贝尔格莱德签署。加布里埃尔·冯·赫伯特-拉特克尔代表奥匈帝国，切多米尔·米亚托维奇代表塞尔维亚公国签署。公约事实上使塞尔维亚成为奥匈帝国的保护国，也令塞尔维亚通过代理方式加入后来的三国同盟（1882年）。

en.s: The Anglo-French Convention of 1882 was signed on 28 June 1882 between Great Britain and France. It confirmed the territorial boundaries between Guinea and Sierra Leone around Conakry and Freetown. However, it was never fully ratified by the French Chamber of Deputies although it was officially recognised by the British Foreign Office.

zh.s: 英国和法国于1882年6月28日签署英法公约，确认了几内亚与塞拉利昂在科纳克里和弗里敦周边的领土边界。该公约始终未完成法国众议院的批准程序，但得到英国外交部正式承认。

zh.s: 圣胡安第三次海战于1898年6月28日爆发，一艘美国辅助巡洋舰拦截了一艘试图突破封锁的西班牙船只。西班牙分舰队试图营救，成功转移船上的补给和船员，但没能救下船只；美国军舰与其交战并迫使它搁浅。

en.s: The Seymour Expedition (Chinese: 西摩爾遠征) was an attempt by a multinational military force led by Admiral Edward Seymour to march to Beijing and relieve the Siege of the Legations from attacks by Qing China government troops and the Boxers in 1900. The Chinese and Boxer fighters defeated the Seymour armies and forced them to return to Tianjin (Tientsin). It was followed later in the summer by the successful Gaselee Expedition.

zh.s: 西摩尔远征是一次由爱德华·西摩尔海军上将率领的多国军事行动，目标是向北京进军，解救遭清政府军队和义和团袭击的使馆区。清军和义和团击败了西摩尔率领的联军，迫使其退回天津。随后，同年夏季晚些时候，盖斯利远征成功抵达北京。

en.t: Roosevelt approves the Spooner Act for a Panama canal
en.s: On June 28, 1902, U.S. President Theodore Roosevelt approved the Spooner Act. It authorized the purchase of the New Panama Canal Company’s assets for no more than $40 million, subject to obtaining suitable canal rights from Colombia.

zh.t: 罗斯福批准关于巴拿马运河的《斯普纳法案》
zh.s: 1902年6月28日，美国总统西奥多·罗斯福批准《斯普纳法案》。法案授权以不超过4000万美元购买新巴拿马运河公司的资产，前提是从哥伦比亚取得适当的运河权利。

en.s: Elections were held in the Australian state of Western Australia on 28 June 1904 to elect 50 members to the state's Legislative Assembly. The election resulted in a hung parliament. The Labour Party, led by Robert Hastie, won 22 seats, while the governing Ministerialists won 18 seats, and independents won 10 seats. Walter James, who had been premier since July 1902, initially continued on in the role after the election.

zh.s: 1904年6月28日，澳大利亚西澳大利亚州举行选举，选出州立法议会50名议员。选举后没有任何政党获得多数：罗伯特·哈斯蒂领导的工党赢得22席，执政部长派赢得18席，无党派人士赢得10席。自1902年7月起担任州长的沃尔特·詹姆斯最初继续留任。

en.s: The 1909 Yukon general election was held on 28 June 1909 to elect the ten members of the Yukon Territorial Council. The council was non-partisan and had merely an advisory role to the federally appointed Commissioner. The 1909 election marked the first time that voters in the territory elected the entire council — in the four prior elections, the council was composed of five elected representatives and five representatives appointed by the Canadian federal government.

zh.s: 1909年6月28日，育空地区举行大选，选出育空地区议会的10名成员。该议会无党派属性，仅向联邦任命的专员提供咨询。此前四次选举中，议会均由5名民选代表和5名加拿大联邦政府任命的代表组成；1909年选举是育空选民首次选出全部议会成员。

en.s: Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria, heir presumptive to the Austro-Hungarian throne, and his wife, Sophie, Duchess of Hohenberg, were assassinated by Bosnian Serb student Gavrilo Princip in Sarajevo on 28 June 1914. They were shot at close range while being driven through the provincial capital of Bosnia and Herzegovina, formally annexed by Austria-Hungary in 1908. The incident was one of the key events that led to World War I.

zh.t: 弗朗茨·斐迪南大公遇刺案
zh.s: 1914年6月28日，奥匈帝国皇储弗朗茨·斐迪南大公及其妻霍恩贝格公爵夫人索菲在萨拉热窝遭波斯尼亚塞族学生加夫里洛·普林西普刺杀。两人乘车经过波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那首府时，遭近距离枪击；奥匈帝国于1908年正式吞并该地。这一事件是第一次世界大战爆发的关键原因之一。

en.s: The Capture of Oppy Wood was an engagement on the Western Front of the Great War on 28 June 1917. The Arras Offensive of 1917 ended with the Germans in possession of a fortified wood to the west of the commune of Oppy, which overlooked British positions. The wood was 1-acre (0.40 ha) in area and contained many German observation posts, machine-guns and trench-mortars. New German defensive tactics adopted after the Battle of the Somme, of defence in depth and rapid counter-attack, had been enforced on the German 6th Army after the disaster of 9 April.

zh.s: 夺取奥皮森林是第一次世界大战西线的一场交战，于1917年6月28日爆发。1917年阿拉斯攻势结束时，德军仍控制着奥皮镇以西的一片设防树林，能够俯瞰英军阵地。树林面积约1英亩（0.40公顷），内有许多德军观察哨、机枪和战壕迫击炮。索姆河战役后，德军第六集团军采用纵深防御和快速反击的新战术；这些战术在4月9日惨败后已投入使用。

en.s: The Treaty of Versailles was a peace treaty signed on 28 June 1919. As the most important treaty of World War I, it ended the state of war between Germany and most of the Allied Powers. It was signed in the Palace of Versailles, exactly five years after the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand, the proximate cause of the war.

zh.s: 《凡尔赛条约》于1919年6月28日签署，是一项和平条约。作为第一次世界大战最重要的条约，它结束了德国与大多数协约国之间的战争状态。条约在凡尔赛宫签署，恰好是奥匈帝国皇储弗朗茨·斐迪南遇刺、即战争直接导火索的五周年。

en.s: The Vidovdan Constitution was the first constitution of the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes. It was approved by the Constitutional Assembly on 28 June 1921 despite the opposition boycotting the vote. The Constitution is named after the feast of St. Vitus (Vidovdan), a Serbian Orthodox holiday. The Constitution required a simple majority to pass. Out of 419 representatives, 223 voted for, 35 voted against and 161 abstained.

zh.s: 维多夫丹宪法是塞尔维亚人、克罗地亚人和斯洛文尼亚人王国的第一部宪法。制宪会议于1921年6月28日通过宪法，反对派抵制了投票。宪法以圣维特节（维多夫丹）命名，这是塞尔维亚东正教节日。宪法只需简单多数票即可通过。419名代表中，223人赞成、35人反对、161人弃权。

en.s: The Svobodny incident (Korean: 자유시 참변; Hanja: 自由市慘變), also known as the Jayu City incident (자유시 사기변; 自由市事庋變) and the Heukha incident (흑하사변; 黑河事變), occurred on June 28, 1921, in Svobodny (Russian for "free") in the Far East Republic (currently Amur Oblast, Russia) where the Korean exiled independence fighters who refused to accept command of the Red Army were surrounded and suppressed.

zh.s: 斯沃博德内事件（韩语：자유시 참변；汉字：自由市惨变）又称自由市事变或黑河事件，于1921年6月28日在远东共和国斯沃博德内（俄语意为“自由”，今属俄罗斯阿穆尔州）发生。拒绝接受红军指挥的朝鲜流亡独立战士遭到包围和镇压。

en.s: The Irish Civil War (Irish: Cogadh Cathartha na hÉireann; 28 June 1922 – 24 May 1923) was a conflict that followed the Irish War of Independence and accompanied the establishment of the Irish Free State, an entity independent from the United Kingdom but within the British Empire. The civil war was waged between the Provisional Government of Ireland and the Anti-Treaty IRA over the Anglo-Irish Treaty.

zh.s: 爱尔兰内战（爱尔兰语：Cogadh Cathartha na hÉireann）于1922年6月28日至1923年5月24日爆发，是爱尔兰独立战争后的冲突，并伴随着爱尔兰自由邦成立。该自由邦脱离英国独立，但仍属于大英帝国。内战交战双方是爱尔兰临时政府和反条约派爱尔兰共和军，双方因《英爱条约》而冲突。

en.s: The 1927 Manitoba general election was held on 28 June 1927 to elect Members of the Legislative Assembly of the province of Manitoba, Canada. en.s: The Battle of the Espero Convoy (Battaglia del convoglio Espero) on 28 June 1940, was the first surface engagement between Italian and Allied warships of the Second World War. Three 36 kn (67 km/h; 41 mph) Italian destroyers made a dash from Taranto for Tobruk in Libya to transport Blackshirt (Milizia Volontaria per la Sicurezza Nazionale) anti-tank units, in case of an armoured attack from Egypt by the British.

zh.s: “埃斯佩罗”船队海战于1940年6月28日爆发，是第二次世界大战期间意大利与盟军军舰之间首次水面交战。三艘航速达36节（每小时67公里）的意大利驱逐舰从塔兰托驶往利比亚托布鲁克，运送黑衫军（国家安全志愿民兵）反坦克部队，以防英国军队从埃及发动装甲进攻。

en.t: Soviet occupation of Bessarabia and Northern Bukovina
en.s: Between 28 June and 3 July 1940, the Soviet Union occupied Bessarabia, Northern Bukovina and the Hertsa region, following an ultimatum made to Romania on 26 June 1940 that threatened the use of force. Those regions, with a total area of 50,762 km2 (19,599 sq mi) and a population of 3,776,309 inhabitants, were incorporated into the Soviet Union.

en.t: 1941 United States Senate special election in Texas
en.s: The 1941 United States Senate special election in Texas was held on June 28, 1941, to complete the unexpired term of Senator Morris Sheppard, who died in office on April 9. Interim Senator Andrew Jackson Houston did not run for re-election and died only two days before the election. The race was won by Governor Pappy O'Daniel with a plurality of the vote; no majority was required.

zh.t: 1941年得克萨斯州美国参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1941年6月28日，得克萨斯州举行美国参议院特别选举，以完成参议员莫里斯·谢泼德的未满任期。谢泼德于4月9日在任内去世。临时参议员安德鲁·杰克逊·休斯敦没有寻求连任，并在选举前两天去世。州长“帕皮”·奥丹尼尔以相对多数票获胜，选举不要求候选人获得过半票数。

en.s: Case Blue (German: Fall Blau) was the Wehrmacht's plan for the 1942 summer offensive in southern Russia between 28 June and 24 November 1942, during World War II. The objective was to capture the oil fields of Baku (Azerbaijan SSR), Grozny and Maikop, to enable the Germans to obtain fuel and also to deny it to the Soviet Union, bringing about the complete collapse of the Soviet war effort.

zh.s: 蓝色方案（德语：Fall Blau）是德意志国防军于第二次世界大战期间制定的1942年夏季攻势计划，计划在6月28日至11月24日进攻俄罗斯南部。目标是夺取巴库（阿塞拜疆苏维埃社会主义共和国）、格罗兹尼和迈科普的油田，让德军获得燃料并切断苏联的石油供应，从而使苏联战争努力彻底崩溃。

en.s: The Bobruysk offensive (Russian: Бобруйская наступательная операция) was part of the Belorussian strategic offensive of the Red Army in summer 1944, commonly known as Operation Bagration. In less than a week in late June 1944, the Soviet 3rd Army broke through in the north of the sector, trapping the German XXXV Corps against the Berezina.

en.s: The Mogilev offensive (Russian: Могилевская наступательная операция) was part of the Belorussian strategic offensive – commonly known as Operation Bagration – of the Red Army on the Eastern Front of World War II in the summer of 1944. Its goals were to capture the city of Mogilev and to pin down and trap the bulk of the German Fourth Army. The offensive fulfilled both objectives.

zh.s: 莫吉廖夫攻势是苏军第二次世界大战东线白俄罗斯战略攻势（通常称巴格拉季昂行动）的一部分，发生于1944年夏季。苏军目标是夺取莫吉廖夫市，并牵制、围困德军第四集团军主力。攻势实现了这两个目标。

en.s: The Vitebsk–Orsha offensive (Russian: Витебско-Оршанская наступательная операция) was part of the Belorussian strategic offensive of the Red Army in summer 1944, commonly known as Operation Bagration. During the offensive, Soviet troops captured Vitebsk and Orsha. A Soviet breakthrough during the offensive helped achieve the encirclement of German troops in the subsequent Minsk offensive.

zh.t: 维捷布斯克—奥尔沙攻势
zh.s: 维捷布斯克—奥尔沙攻势是苏军1944年夏季白俄罗斯战略攻势（通常称巴格拉季昂行动）的一部分。攻势期间，苏军攻占维捷布斯克和奥尔沙。苏军突破防线，为随后明斯克攻势围歼德军创造了条件。

en.t: Republicans nominate John Bricker as Thomas Dewey’s running mate
en.s: On June 28, 1944, the Republican National Convention in Chicago nominated Ohio governor John W. Bricker for vice president as Thomas Dewey’s running mate.

zh.t: 共和党提名约翰·布里克为杜威的竞选搭档
zh.s: 1944年6月28日，美国共和党全国代表大会在芝加哥提名俄亥俄州州长约翰·布里克为副总统候选人，与托马斯·杜威搭档参选。

en.s: The Battle of Beaufort took place during the Second World War between Allied and Japanese forces. Part of the wider Borneo campaign of the Pacific War, it was fought between 26 and 28 June 1945 in North Borneo (later known as Sabah). The battle formed part of the Allied efforts to secure North Borneo in the final months of the war and saw two Australian infantry battalions attack the town, which was held by a force of around 800 – 1,000 Japanese.

zh.s: 博福特战役于第二次世界大战期间在盟军和日军之间爆发，是太平洋战争婆罗洲战役的一部分，战斗于1945年6月26日至28日在北婆罗洲（今沙巴）进行。盟军希望在战争最后几个月控制北婆罗洲，两支澳大利亚步兵营进攻由约800至1,000名日军把守的城镇。

en.t: Poland's Soviet-allied Provisional Government of National Unity is formed over a month after V-E Day
en.s: The Provisional Government of National Unity (Polish: Tymczasowy Rząd Jedności Narodowej, TRJN) was a provisional government formed by the decree of the State National Council (Krajowa Rada Narodowa, KRN) on 28 June 1945 as a result of reshuffling the Soviet-backed Provisional Government of the Republic of Poland established by the Polish Workers' Party (Polska Partia Robotnicza, PPR) through inclusion of politicians from the close political sphere of Stanisław Mikołajczyk, the former prime minister of the Polish government-in-exile based in London.

zh.t: 波兰民族团结临时政府成立
zh.s: 波兰民族团结临时政府（波兰语：Tymczasowy Rząd Jedności Narodowej，简称TRJN）于1945年6月28日由国家民族委员会（KRN）颁令成立。此前，波兰工人党（PPR）建立的苏联支持的波兰共和国临时政府进行改组，纳入了斯坦尼斯瓦夫·米科瓦伊奇克的政治盟友。米科瓦伊奇克曾任设在伦敦的波兰流亡政府总理。

en.s: Election of the Provisional Head of the Italian State (June 28, 1946) After the departure of King Umberto II of Italy (June 13, 1946), the functions of head of state had provisionally exercised by the Prime Minister Alcide De Gasperi, to which were entrusted to the beginning of July when, following his election as Provisional Head of State, Enrico De Nicola was sworn in before the Constituent Assembly. They should not be considered the presidential elections, as this institution does not yet exist. However, the same De Nicola assumes this title according to the first transitional provision of the Constitution in 1948.

zh.t: 1946年意大利临时国家元首选举
zh.s: 1946年6月28日，意大利选出恩里科·德尼科拉为临时国家元首。此前，翁贝托二世国王于6月13日离境，国家元首职权暂由总理阿尔契德·德加斯佩里行使。德尼科拉于7月初在制宪会议前宣誓就职。当时尚未设立总统一职，因此这不是总统选举；德尼科拉后来依据1948年宪法第一项过渡条款取得总统称号。

en.s: The 1948 New Brunswick general election was held on June 28, 1948, to elect 52 members to the 41st New Brunswick Legislative Assembly, the governing house of the province of New Brunswick, Canada. The Liberal government of John B. McNair was re-elected. The election was held using 17 districts, electing between two and five members each, through Block Voting.

zh.s: 1948年6月28日，加拿大新不伦瑞克省举行大选，选出该省第41届立法议会的52名议员。约翰·B·麦克奈尔领导的自由党政府连任。选举采用区块投票制，分为17个选区，每个选区选出2至5名议员。

en.s: The Hangang Bridge bombing (Korean: 한강 인도교 폭파, Hanja: 漢江人道橋爆破) was a demolition conducted by the South Korean Army to destroy the Hangang Bridge in Seoul, South Korea on 28 June 1950. On 25 June 1950, North Korea invaded South Korea, sparking the Korean war. South Korean President Rhee Syngman called for the defense of Seoul to the death. On 27 June, early morning, Rhee Syngman evacuated himself from Seoul by special train with the other government officials. At 11:00 am, the South Korean Army headquarters decided to destroy the Hangang Bridge to stop the North Korean invasion and gave up defending Seoul.

zh.s: 1950年6月28日，韩国军方在首尔炸毁汉江大桥。6月25日，朝鲜入侵韩国，朝鲜战争爆发。李承晚总统号召誓死保卫首尔。6月27日清晨，李承晚和其他政府官员乘专列撤出首尔。当日上午11时，韩国军方总部决定炸毁汉江大桥，以阻止朝鲜军队进攻，并放弃保卫首尔。

en.s: The Seoul National University Hospital massacre (Korean: 서울대학교 부속병원 학살 사건; Hanja: 서울國立大學校附属病院虐殺事件) was a massacre of 700 to 900 doctors, nurses, inpatient civilians, and wounded soldiers by the Korean People's Army (KPA) on 28 June 1950 at the Seoul National University Hospital, Seoul district of South Korea. During the First Battle of Seoul, the KPA wiped out one platoon which guarded Seoul National University Hospital on 28 June 1950.

zh.s: 1950年6月28日，朝鲜人民军在韩国首尔的首尔大学医院屠杀了700至900名医生、护士、住院平民和伤兵。在第一次首尔战役期间，朝鲜人民军还歼灭了一个负责守卫医院的排。

en.s: The Battle of Kaesong–Munsan–Bongilcheon (Hangul: 개성–문산–봉일천 전투; Hanja: 開城–汶山–奉日川 戰鬪) was a series of battles that occurred along the western region of the 38th parallel between 25 and 28 June 1950, as part of Operation Pokpoong (North Korea) and Operation Western Region (South Korea) that marked the beginning of the Korean War.

zh.s: 开城—文山—奉日川战役（韩语：개성–문산–봉일천 전투；汉字：開城–汶山–奉日川 戰鬪）是1950年6月25日至28日在三八线西段发生的一系列战斗，属于朝鲜的“暴风行动”和韩国的“西部地区行动”，这两场行动标志着朝鲜战争爆发。

en.s: The Operation Western Region (Hangul: 서부지역 작전; Hanja: 西部地域 作戰) was a defensive operation conducted by the Republic of Korea Armed Forces (ROK) between 25 and 28 June 1950 against the Operation Pokpung of the Korean People's Army (KPA) during the beginning of the Korean War. On 25 June 1950, the KPA I Corps launched a surprising attack on the ROK forces located in the western region of the 38th Parallel.

zh.s: 西部地区作战（韩语：서부지역 작전；汉字：西部地域 作戰）是韩国武装部队于1950年6月25日至28日实施的一场防御作战，旨在应对朝鲜人民军的“暴风行动”。1950年6月25日，朝鲜人民军第一军突然袭击了韩国军队在三八线西段的阵地。

en.s: The Bodo League massacre (Korean: 보도연맹 학살; Hanja: 保導聯盟虐殺) was the mass killing of alleged communists and communist sympathizers by South Korean forces in the summer of 1950, during the Korean War. Many victims were civilians who had no connection to communism or communists. Estimates of the death toll vary, with historians estimating that between 60,000 and 200,000 people were killed.
en.n: Korean War: Suspected communist sympathizers (between 60,000 and 200,000) are executed in the Bodo League massacre.

zh.s: 1950年夏朝鲜战争期间，韩国军队大规模杀害被怀疑是共产主义者或同情共产主义者的人。许多受害者是与共产主义或共产主义者毫无关系的平民。死亡人数估计不一，历史学家估计有6万至20万人遇难。

en.t: United States Senate special election in North Dakota, 1960
en.s: The 1960 Special U.S. Senate election for the state of North Dakota was held June 28, 1960, to fill the United States Senate seat vacated by the late William Langer. Langer died in office on November 8, 1959, and Clarence Norman Brunsdale, a former Governor of North Dakota, was temporarily appointed to the seat on November 19 of that year until the special election was held. North Dakota Democratic-NPL Party candidate Quentin N. Burdick faced Republican John E. Davis for election to the seat. Davis had been serving as Governor of the state since 1957.

zh.t: 1960年北达科他州美国参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1960年6月28日，北达科他州举行美国参议院特别选举，填补威廉·兰格去世后留下的席位。兰格于1959年11月8日在任内去世；前州长克拉伦斯·诺曼·布伦斯代尔于同年11月19日获临时任命接任该席位，直到特别选举举行。北达科他州民主党—无党派联盟候选人昆廷·N·伯迪克与共和党人约翰·E·戴维斯角逐席位。戴维斯自1957年起担任州长。

en.s: The Argentine Revolution (Spanish: Revolución Argentina) is the self-styled name of the civil-military dictatorship that overthrew the constitutional president Arturo Illia through a coup d'état on June 28, 1966, and ruled the country until May 25, 1973. The dictatorship did not present itself as a "provisional government" (as all the previous coups had done in Argentina), but rather sought to establish itself as a new permanent dictatorial system later associated with the concept of the bureaucratic-authoritarian State.

zh.s: “阿根廷革命”是1966年6月28日政变推翻宪政总统阿图罗·伊利亚后，文官与军方联合独裁政权的自称，统治持续至1973年5月25日。与此前阿根廷历次政变不同，这个政权没有自称“临时政府”，而是试图建立长期独裁体制，后来与“官僚威权国家”的概念联系在一起。

en.s: The 1967 Irish local elections were held in all the counties, cities and towns of Ireland on 28 June 1967. The result was a large gain in seats for Fine Gael, while Fianna Fáil and Labour remained largely unchanged on net seat totals. Others, including independents and Sinn Féin, lost many seats. The context of the elections was an Ireland in the process of rapid modernisation. Social changes since the 1960 local elections include the launch of the first national television network, Telefís Éireann, in 1961. The National Farmers Association campaigned against the Fianna Fáil government, which was reducing tariffs in preparation for European Economic Community membership.

zh.s: 1967年6月28日，爱尔兰各郡、市和镇举行地方选举。爱尔兰统一党大幅增加席位，共和党和工党的席位总数大致持平；包括独立人士和新芬党在内的其他候选人则失去许多席位。当时爱尔兰正迅速现代化。自1960年地方选举以来，社会发生了变化，包括1961年首个全国电视网络“爱尔兰电视台”开播。全国农民协会反对共和党政府为加入欧洲经济共同体而降低关税的政策。

en.s: An election to all 28 seats on Donegal County Council took place on 28 June 1967 as part of the Irish local elections. en.s: Regents of the University of California v. en.s: Aeroflot Flight 8641 was a Yakovlev Yak-42 airliner on a domestic scheduled passenger flight from Leningrad (now Saint Petersburg) to Kiev (now Kyiv). On 28 June 1982, the flight crashed south of Mazyr, Byelorussian SSR, killing all 132 people on board. The accident was both the first and deadliest crash of a Yakovlev Yak-42, and remains the deadliest aviation accident in Belarus.

en.s: On 28 June 1987, Iraq dropped mustard gas bombs on Sardasht, West Azerbaijan, Iran. In two separate bombing runs on four residential areas, the attack killed 130 people and injured 8,000. The gas attacks occurred during the Iran–Iraq War when Iraq frequently used chemical weapons against Iranian civilians and soldiers. In 2006, a quarter of the town's 20,000 residents were still experiencing severe illnesses from the attacks.

en.s: An election for the office of President of Iceland was planned to be held in Iceland on 28 June 2008. Ástþór Magnússon, who ran unsuccessfully in 1996 and 2004, ruled out a candidacy. No challenger to the incumbent president filed by the deadline to declare a candidacy on 24 May 2008, and so Ólafur Ragnar's fourth term was won uncontested. He was sworn in on 1 August 2008.

This was the sixth show in WWE's production lineage for The Great American Bash event (twentieth overall) and the only one to be referred to as The Bash. en.s: The 2009 Honduran coup d'état occurred during the 2009 Honduran constitutional crisis. It was triggered after President Manuel Zelaya refused to comply with a Honduran Supreme Court ruling. On 28 June 2009, the Honduran Army ousted Zelaya and sent him into exile. Zelaya had sought to schedule a non-binding poll on convening a constituent assembly to write a new constitution (the fourth ballot box referendum).

en.s: The 2009 FIFA Confederations Cup final was an association football match that took place on 28 June 2009 to determine the winners of the 2009 FIFA Confederations Cup. It was played at Ellis Park Stadium in Johannesburg, South Africa, and was contested by the United States and Brazil. The United States, playing in their first major men's tournament final, took a 2–0 lead in the first half, but Brazil scored three unanswered goals after half-time to win 3–2.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Poland on 28 June 2020. As no candidate received a majority of the vote, a second round was held on 12 July, in which incumbent president Andrzej Duda, running with the support of the incumbent government of the Law and Justice (PiS) party, faced off against Civic Platform vice-chairman and Mayor of Warsaw Rafał Trzaskowski.

zh.s: 波兰于2020年6月28日举行总统选举。由于没有候选人获得过半选票，7月12日举行第二轮投票。获得执政法律与公正党支持的现任总统安杰伊·杜达，对阵公民纲领党副主席、华沙市长拉法乌·特扎斯科夫斯基。

en.s: The 2020 Paris Municipal election was a municipal election that took place in Paris on 15 March 2020, alongside other French municipal elections. The second round, which was originally scheduled to be held on 22 March 2020, was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic in France. The second round then took place on 28 June 2020, which saw Anne Hidalgo re-elected as Mayor of Paris.

en.s: The 2022 Nebraska's 1st congressional district special election, which was held on June 28, 2022, was triggered when Republican representative Jeff Fortenberry resigned on March 31, having been convicted of lying to the FBI about campaign contributions. Under Nebraska state law, major party nominees for special elections are selected by the party through its executive committee or party convention, with the special election scheduled by Governor Pete Ricketts within 90 days after the seat's vacancy.

zh.t: 2022年内布拉斯加州第一国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 2022年6月28日，内布拉斯加州第一国会选区举行特别选举。共和党众议员杰夫·福滕伯里于3月31日辞职，引发此次选举；此前他因就竞选捐款问题向联邦调查局撒谎而被定罪。根据内布拉斯加州法律，特别选举的主要政党候选人由党执行委员会或党代表大会选出；州长皮特·里基茨须在席位空缺后90天内安排特别选举。

en.s: Early presidential elections in Iran were held on 28 June and 5 July 2024 following the death of incumbent president Ebrahim Raisi in a helicopter crash on 19 May. Four candidates contested the first round of the election, in which Masoud Pezeshkian won 44%, Saeed Jalili won 40%, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf won 14% and Mostafa Pourmohammadi won less than 1% of the vote.

en.s: The 2025 Major League Rugby Championship Final was the seventh Major League Rugby (MLR) championship match, held at the conclusion of the eighth season of the rugby union club competition in North America.
